55377.sn: I want your fellowship; I want your God to be my God, and I want to live with you for ever, in time and eternity.

55378.sn: …been adopted into the family of Christ through the bonds of the everlasting covenant, and all can then exclaim, in the beautiful language of Ruth, "Thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God!"…

55380.sn: …and brought you here, for you felt like one of old, when she said, "Whither thou goest I will go; thy God shall be my God, thy people shall be my people, and where thou diest there will I be buried."…

55381.sn: …are today, and ever have been, like one of old, when she said: "This people shall be my people, their God shall be my God; where they live I will live also, where they die there I want to be buried ;"…

55382.sn: This people's God is my God, their religion is my religion, where they go I hope to be found, where they live I wish to live, where they die I want to be buried.

55383.sn: …admires; and he feels to say in his heart, as one said in former days: "Let this people be my people, let their God be my God; where they live let me live also, and where they die let me be buried;…

55384.sn: And I feel to say, as one said in old times—that with this people I desire to live, and, if it is necessary to die, I desire to have the privilege of dying with them.

55385.sn: …of Israel go and glean wheat, they may be like the woman anciently, increase all around: she had been a barren woman formerly, but gleaning wheat put her in the notion of getting—— I can't say it.

55386.sn: See also Ruth iii and iv.)

55387.sn: From that alliance sprang the noblest men that were in Israel—Obed, Jesse, David, Solomon, and through Boaz and Ruth came the Son of God.

55388.sn: See also Ruth iii and iv.)
